items.title: Milestone 3: Final validation pass: live integrations, tests and retention drill
items.body: Validated the whole system against the real services: 82 backend tests, 58 live checks, 13 Swift tests on Linux, all iOS sources parsed, the Xcode project structurally validated, and a live retention drill through the systemd unit.

items.title: Milestone 2: Retention drill: 7-day cleanup verified
items.body: Self-test of the automatic screenshot retention: one screenshot is aged past its window, the systemd retention unit is run, and the file must disappear while the milestone text survives.
